sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl<0) AS losses, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) AS pnl, round(avg(assumed_price)::numeric,1) AS avg_px, count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS events FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='mmsell10' AND status='settled' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC
